correctness.rationale: The derivative of f^t for a finite-field first-zero r avoids 0 along the preceding orbit, so is a unit for odd p; Hensel gives one unique root rho_r and the factorized difference makes valuation v_p(f^t(x))=v_p(x-rho_r) on that residue ball. For nonzero y in zero class f²(y)=y²(y²-2), with y²-2 a p-adic unit (odd p), giving valuation doubling until modulus cutoff. Entry to -1 occurs at t+2h_k(s)+1, with exceptional canonical lift -1 already of depth0. Summing exactly (p-1)p^{k-s-1} points in each valuation shell yields the polynomial and basin total. Independent direct graph iteration matched predicted histogram in 9 (p,k) cases, not a proof of all levels. Maximum comes from s=1 shell and largest finite-field t; checks k=1 boundary separately.
